title: MyJFrog API token in a Bearer header
summary: A synthetic MyJFrog API token after the Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of a MyJFrog Portal API request, in a raw request, a quoted curl -H argument and a JSON header map.
rationale: JFrog documents the MyJFrog Portal API authentication as a bearer token in the Authorization header, with tokens generated by a Primary Admin. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width, and does not say whether the token is a JFrog Platform access token, so no value shape and no platform access token attribution is implied. The Bearer scheme is generic, so the attribution stays generic; the extent is the value after the scheme and excludes the closing quote.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value after an explicit Bearer scheme in an Authorization header of a MyJFrog Portal API request is treated as a credential and covered whole. JFrog documents the Bearer header form for the MyJFrog Portal API (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and generic authorization attribution are the project's decisions.
